 Commanders activate Amos, Magee, McNichols; place Croskey-Merritt, Jean-Baptiste to IR list
 Oct 19, 2026 at 03:59 PM Zach Selby Senior Writer
 Copied! 
 LOUDOUN COUNTY, Va. – The Washington Commanders announced today that they have made the following roster moves:
 The Washington Commanders have activated the following players from the Reserve/Injured List:
 CB Trey Amos
 LB Jordan Magee
 RB Jeremy McNichols
 The Washington Commanders have placed the following players on the Reserve/Injured List:
 RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt
 OLB Javontae Jean-Baptiste
 The Washington Commanders have released the following player:
 LB Austin Keys
 The Washington Commanders have elevated the following player from the practice squad:
 OLB T.J. Maguranyanga
 CB Trey Amos (Ankle), LB Jordan Magee (Hamstring) and RB Jeremy McNichols (Quad) have all been upgraded from questionable and removed from the injury report.
